100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 16, 1926, tensions escalated in the Middle East as a violent uprising in Palestine led to clashes between Arab and Jewish communities, drawing international attention. In the United States, the aviation industry celebrated a significant milestone with the completion of the first transcontinental air mail route, promising faster communication across the nation. Meanwhile, in Europe, the aftermath of the Treaty of Versailles continued to spark political unrest, as Germany faced economic challenges that threatened stability.
